title: Unmixed and mixed knots across two shifts
claim: Proved by hand (with the advisor model): copies of a harmony along two shifts with unmixed knots lock exactly when both rings lock (945 of 945 cells), and stepped states are states. Exact on the range: with the mixed knot (Ledrappier's three-member shape), 2,880 cells n, m = 2..9 on 45 harmonies: in 78 cells (10 harmonies) the arrangement unlocks only through states repeating along no short step; such states occur in 34 harmonies; none on squares to 16 (675 of 675); no harmony's increments hold a line; the Ledrappier control unlocks at the advisor's sizes and at 31 has no short-step state; ring ties n, n/L or copy 0 alone (403 of 405). After the run: those states verified, repeat along no step, tie nothing; for 0011 + 01 they are tilings and a slope polygon decides every lock to 16 x 16. Referee pending.
failure_conditions: An unmixed-knot repeat whose locking disagrees with both rings locking.
A stepped state that is not a state.
A cell counted for H0 or H0' that a fresh run settles the other way.
remaining_obligations: Independent referee (the background referee thread): pending.
foundation_claim_scope: The plain not-all-equal law; 45 harmonies of period <= 16 stitched in one order; copies along two shifts on n x m repeats (unmixed knots 3..8; the mixed knot 2..9 and squares to 16; after the run, lock shapes to 16 x 16); rings of 6 to 60 knots; Ledrappier's law to 32 as control.
